name: Lucas Barbosa dos Santos
bio1: Full-stack developer and a student of Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Itaquera. My journey in technology is driven by a passion for creating functional solutions and the ambition to become a Game Developer.
bio2: With a strong interest in Design and UX/UI, I always seek to combine code with an intuitive and visually impactful user experience in my projects.
softSkill1_desc: Ability to collaborate with other developers and designers to achieve common goals.
softSkill2_desc: Focus on analyzing complex challenges, identifying root causes, and implementing efficient and robust solutions.
softSkill3_desc: Initiative to anticipate problems, seek continuous improvements, and learn new technologies.
extra2_desc: Knowledge in image editing, asset creation, and layout manipulation for web projects.
